title: Silver resolved token index v1
description: A fully-resolved DTCG token tree — every {reference} alias flattened to its literal $value. This is the canonical, implementation-agnostic artifact external tools, production, and doctor consume; it is generated from the authored tokens/ tree and never hand-edited. Recursive: any key that is not a DTCG token itself groups further tokens.

token.description: $type may be inherited from an ancestor group rather than declared on the leaf itself, so only $value is required here.
